findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_yield_curve" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Returns the current fitted Gavel yield curve for the requested collateral/loan pair. Rates are oracle-free, derived from auctions in The Gavel Protocol. The cur…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_onchain_indicators" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
